creator: Claude Code (claude-sonnet-5-5) worker session tien-nghich-2d-29, 2026-11-22
method: create_character_pro_flash (32x32 native, low top-down, mannequin template, 8 views, 40-colour palette, seed 7) then animate_character v3 per direction. All four facings are separate PixelLab generations; nothing is mirrored.
prompt: Stocky xianxia bell founder, small human in a short dark-brown work tunic with rolled sleeves, thick grey-blue forearm wrapping, bald head with a headband. In the RIGHT hand a bronze handbell held up at his side with a clapper; the LEFT hand wears a thick brown leather glove that reaches the elbow (asymmetric), the other hand bare. Front-facing 3/4 top-down, chibi large head, chunky pixel art, 1px dark outline, light from top-left.
